```yaml
name: Update Browserslist DB

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * 1'  # Every Monday at 2 AM UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update-browserslist:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 'lts/*'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Update browserslist database
        run: npx update-browserslist-db@latest

      - name: Check for changes
        id: git-check
        run: |
          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
            echo "has_changes=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "has_changes=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Commit and push changes
        if: steps.git-check.outputs.has_changes == 'true'
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add .
          git commit -m "chore: update browserslist db" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/update/browserslist-db || echo "No changes to push"

      - name: Create pull request
        if: steps.git-check.outputs.has_changes == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: update/browserslist-db
          title: "chore: update browserslist db"
          body: "This PR updates the browserslist database to the latest version."
          commit-message: "chore: update browserslist db"
          signoff: false
          delete-branch: true
```
